shortDescription: The Bank of Japan’s decision to speed up sales of exchange-traded funds could increase its payments to the government, potentially helping Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi finance her policy agenda, according to Bloomberg.

title: BOJ ETF Sales Acceleration Could Support Takaichi’s Spending Agenda
